dataset.source: Smith et al. (2026) Water Research 288:124685; EPA ScienceHub doi:10.23719/1532427 (U.S. public domain)

implementationNotes: C0 = 1: values are C/C0 as published (amendment A1); RMSE is therefore already a fraction of C0.

A curve fitted to one sampling point alone (STATIC_OUTLET_ASYM, TWOPOINT_ASYM, E8) needs at least 2 samples at that point; otherwise the method has no curve for that species and the species is left out of the pooled S2 score (PFOA, the primary species, has at least 26 samples at every point of every train).
Pooled S2 uses only species for which every method has a curve and the case has test samples.

Reference scatter: PFOA outlet samples of one replicate against the other replicate's outlet series linearly interpolated at the same run time (only inside the other series' time range), both directions pooled, per experiment and NOM condition; the decision rule uses the mean over the four conditions.
Secondary variant (port + outlet samples up to the cut-off) is run for TWIN, TWIN_ASYM and TWOPOINT_ASYM.
Crossings are searched on whole days up to 3000 days, then bisected (core.crossing_day); a forecast that never crosses in that window is reported as 3000 and classified as late.
